long_description:
Join Goat Yoga DFW for a whimsical outdoor experience at Lakewood Brewing Company! Get ready to unlock the joy within as you indulge in a unique fusion of fun adventure yoga meditation and breathwork all under the open sky surrounded by nature's beauty. Cuddle Playdate the hour after class included with class ticket purchase.

Immerse yourself in a session led by the captivating keynote speakers - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting goats promising an unforgettable blend of relaxation and amusement.

Calling all happy fun animal lovers! Unleash your inner child and connect with these charming creatures as you flow through yoga poses in the company of adorable four-legged companions.

Embark on a journey of wellness and laughter surrounded by a welcoming community of like-minded individuals. Remember to bring your own mat and don your most comfortable attire that covers your back and shoulders.

In case you forget your gear worry not as shirts are available for purchase at $25 so you can fully embrace the spirit of this extraordinary experience.

Tickets are available exclusively on AllEvents. Seize this opportunity to unwind rejuvenate and bask in the warmth of furry companionship. Not your average yoga class this event promises moments of pure delight and connection with nature.

Don't miss out on this chance to create treasured memories with our furry friends. Join us for an enchanting session where goats may not pee or poop on you but they'll certainly leap into your heart. Embrace the unexpected cuddle up and let the serenity of goat yoga sweep you off your feet!
street_address: 2302 Executive Dr, Garland, TX 75041, United States
